title: Statistical Adversaries: Natural Backdoor-like Adversarial Features in Clean Vision Datasets
abstract: arXiv:2607.05516v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Model-specific adversarial attacks have been extensively studied. We study a different failure mode: naturally occurring statistical signals in vision data that can behave as backdoor-like triggers without being maliciously inserted. We call these signals statistical adversaries. We analyse ImageNet to find patterns that are strongly linked to certain labels. We then use statistical controls to remove random correlations from our candidate signals. Finally, we demonstrate that these signals directly and predictably alter model predictions. These statistical adversaries are more targeted than generic corruptions and transfer across different model architectures. This suggests that some vulnerabilities are driven by dataset structure and distribution rather than a single model's idiosyncrasies. translated_title: 统计对手：干净视觉数据集中自然存在的后门样对抗特征
translated_abstract: arXiv:2607.05516v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：针对特定模型的对抗攻击已被广泛研究。我们研究了一种不同的故障模式：视觉数据中自然存在的统计信号，它们可以像后门触发器一样发挥作用，而无需恶意插入。我们将这些信号称为统计对手。我们分析ImageNet，以找到与特定标签强烈相关的模式。然后，我们使用统计控制方法从候选信号中去除随机相关性。最后，我们证明这些信号直接且可预测地改变模型预测。这些统计对手比通用扰动更具针对性，并能跨不同模型架构迁移。这表明某些漏洞是由数据集结构和分布驱动的，而非单一模型的特殊性质。我们得出结论，即使在无投毒的情况下，普通数据集也可能包含可利用的对抗表面，并建议对数据集进行更细致的审查。
tldr: 本论文发现干净视觉数据集中自然存在的统计信号可作为后门样触发器，揭示了数据集结构和分布导致的模型漏洞，而非恶意插入。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that naturally occurring statistical signals in clean vision datasets can act as backdoor-like triggers, highlighting dataset-driven vulnerabilities in models without malicious insertion.
